Git Commit Message Generator

Build Conventional Commits (type/scope/subject) and validate existing messages against the spec.

📖 How to use

  1. Pick a type, optional scope, and subject — or paste a message to validate.
  2. Add a body or breaking-change note if needed.
  3. Click Generate or Validate.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What format does it generate?

The builder always emits type(scope): subject, plus optional body and BREAKING CHANGE footer.

Which types are supported?

feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore, and revert.

What does the validator check?

It checks the type/scope/subject pattern, subject length, capitalization, and trailing period.

Can I mark breaking changes?

Yes — tick “breaking change” and describe it; a BREAKING CHANGE: footer is appended.
